Note the declared HS set (293399;294200;820730;842139) does not match the observed shipment HS codes (84223000, 84229090, 84799090, 84799040, 830015) — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the actual codes are machinery/spare-parts codes and the declared list should be corrected to the observed ones. Domestic supply side: no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or contract record could be retrieved — zaubacorp, thecompanycheck and eximpedia all returned HTTP 403 and the search backend was down (searx connection refused), so domestic_status is unknown, not none_found. Revenue and export volume figures are null: ImportKey shows only a shipment-count counter (20079) with no value data, and no audited revenue was publicly retrievable. PAN AAACP4776H and state Maharashtra were not independently verified in this pass (registry scope excluded).
